name: Tina2 Basic 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
;FLAVOR:Marlin
M82 ;absolute extrusion mode
;MachineType:Weedo Tina2 Basic
;FilamentType:PLA
;Extruder0Temperature:[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
;(** start.gcode for tina2**)
M203 Z15
M104 S150
G28 Z
G28 X Y; Home extruder
G1 X55 Y55 F1000
G29
M107 ; Turn off fan
G90 ; Absolute positioning
M82 ; Extruder in absolute mode
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
G92 E0 ; Reset extruder position
G1 X90 Y6 Z0.27 F2000
G1 X20 Y6 Z0.27 E15 F1000
G92 E0 ; Reset extruder position
M203 Z5
machine_end_gcode:
;(** end.gcode for tina2**)
M203 Z15
M104 S0
M107
G92 E0
G0 E-1 F300
G28 Z F300
G28 X0 Y0
G1 Y90 F1000
